question: What is the API 610 classification, design capacity, and rated differential head of Crude Distillation Feed Pump P-101?
expected_sources: Sulzer API 610 Heavy Duty Centrifugal Pump Manual - P-101A/B, p.12
expected_answer: Pump P-101 is an API 610 Type OH2 single-stage, radially split, centerline-mounted centrifugal pump with a design capacity of 360 m3/h and a rated differential head of 145 meters.

question: What are the vibration velocity RMS alarm threshold and the motor/bearing high-high trip temperature limits for P-101?
expected_sources: Sulzer API 610 Heavy Duty Centrifugal Pump Manual - P-101A/B, p.42, p.58
expected_answer: The vibration alarm limit on the bearing housing is 4.5 mm/s RMS. Normal bearing temperature is 65-80 deg C, with High Alarm (HA) at 110 deg C and High-High Alarm (HHA) trip at 130 deg C.

question: What maintenance observations and delays were recorded during the recent quarterly audit for Pump P-101?
expected_sources: MRPL Preventive Maintenance Schedule Log - CDU-1, p.12
expected_answer: The drive-end bearing inspection is 45 days overdue. Previous lube oil analysis showed particulate contamination, and measured radial bearing clearance was 0.08 mm against the nominal 0.04-0.06 mm tolerance.

question: What root causes does the OEM manual list for high-frequency vibration spikes on the P-101 bearing housing?
expected_sources: Sulzer API 610 Heavy Duty Centrifugal Pump Manual - P-101A/B, p.42
expected_answer: The OEM manual identifies bearing inner/outer race degradation, excessive radial clearance, loss of lubrication film viscosity, and mechanical unbalance/misalignment as primary causes of high-frequency vibration spikes.

question: What standard lubrication oil grade and moisture limits are specified in the refinery rotating equipment SOP for P-101?
expected_sources: Refinery-wide Rotating Equipment Lubrication Management SOP, p.19
expected_answer: ISO VG 46 or 68 synthetic hydrocarbon oil is required with moisture content maintained strictly below 100 ppm and particle cleanliness level compliant with ISO 18/16/13.

question: Identify the suction isolation valve, suction strainer, and non-return check valve tags on the P-101 P&ID diagram.
expected_sources: MRPL CDU-1 Crude Feed System P&ID, Drawing Sheet 1
expected_answer: On P&ID DWG-CDU-P101-PID-01, the suction line includes 12" gate isolation valve MOV-1011, duplex basket strainer ST-101, and the discharge line contains non-return check valve NRV-101 followed by motorized discharge valve MOV-1012.

question: Based on the cross-sectional assembly drawing DWG-P101-MECH-04, what bearing types are installed at the drive end (DE) and non-drive end (NDE)?
expected_sources: Sulzer Pump P-101 General Assembly Cross-Section Drawing
expected_answer: The assembly drawing shows a single-row cylindrical roller bearing (NU 318) on the drive end (DE) for radial loads, and a back-to-back duplex angular contact ball bearing pair (7318 BECBM) on the non-drive end (NDE) for combined radial and bidirectional thrust loads.

question: According to the pump performance curve diagram DWG-P101-CURVE-02, what is the Net Positive Suction Head Required (NPSHr) and efficiency at rated capacity of 360 m3/h?
expected_sources: Sulzer P-101 Certified Performance Curve Sheet
expected_answer: At the rated operating capacity of 360 m3/h, the performance curve indicates an NPSHr of 3.8 meters and a pump hydraulic efficiency of 82.5% at the Best Efficiency Point (BEP).

question: Cross-reference the high vibration alarm on P-101 with the P&ID diagram to identify the location of vibration transmitter VT-101 and temperature sensor TE-101.
expected_answer: Vibration transmitter VT-101 and RTD temperature element TE-101 are mounted directly on the drive-end bearing housing of pump P-101A, feeding real-time signals to DCS controller block 10-TIC-101 and 10-VIC-101.

question: Using the mechanical seal SOP and P&ID drawing, explain how the Plan 53A barrier fluid loop provides seal integrity for P-101.
expected_answer: Plan 53A utilizes an external seal barrier fluid reservoir pressurized with nitrogen to 1.5 bar above pump stuffing box pressure. The P&ID shows cooling coils and level transmitter LT-101 on the seal pot, where a drop in fluid level proves barrier fluid loss across primary seal faces.

question: Correlate the maintenance report clearance measurements with the pump cross-sectional drawing to evaluate risk of impeller casing contact.
expected_answer: The maintenance log recorded radial clearance at 0.08 mm (double normal allowable). Cross-sectional drawing DWG-P101-MECH-04 specifies minimum wear ring diametrical clearance of 0.35 mm; while wear ring rub has not yet occurred, bearing deflection under 4.85 mm/s vibration creates immediate risk of dynamic casing contact.

question: Synthesizing suction pressure telemetry (1.9 bar) with P&ID line 12"-CR-101 and pump NPSH curve, determine if Pump P-101 is operating with sufficient suction margin to prevent cavitation.
expected_sources: Sulzer API 610 Heavy Duty Centrifugal Pump Manual - P-101A/B
expected_answer: Suction pressure of 1.9 bar yields an Available NPSH (NPSHa) of 6.2 m after suction strainer losses on 12" line CR-101. Since NPSHr is 3.8 m from curve DWG-P101-CURVE-02, the suction margin is 2.4 m (>1.0 m required by API 610), confirming that cavitation is not the primary driver of current vibration.
